title: Next: Reserve Margin
summary: Closing splash carries forward the crew's new willingness to be constrained and points at the next pressure: safeguards cannot create water when the basin itself is short.
panelPlan: Full-page closing splash at an ordinary community distribution point in late light: measured containers, simple meters and people taking only allocated amounts. Keep the scene calm, practical and visibly constrained.
A distant Launch-Shop or flight trace may sit high in the composition, but the foreground belongs to finite water and the physical act of measuring it.
Do not show reservoir ledgers, premium agricultural draws, Tethergrid emergency restrictions, the Dryline investigation or any Issue 5 evidence.
Make BUT RULES DO NOT CREATE WATER the visual turn, then let the final line narrow into NEXT: RESERVE MARGIN.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: A pump went dark and the basin kept its limit.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: The rocket flew even when the ground lost sight of it.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: For once, refusing control was the thing that kept both systems honest.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: But rules do not create water.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: And when the basin itself starts running short, every margin becomes a choice about who gets less.

directionInline.text: Non-diegetic closing teaser. Preserve exact caption text. Use only outcomes the reader has just seen. The next-issue promise is scarcity and tradeoff; do not reveal the preexisting decline, premium-contract evidence, public ledgers, navigation decisions or any later Issue 5 result.
